facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psappsrt:psAddGeneratorAppSRT
facts.value: Creates the scale/rotation/translation control record used to apply an application-level transform to a particle generator; its initial identity values ensure that attaching a newly created record does not alter the generator until the transform is changed.
facts.reason: Exact component defaults are attested, but full identity/unchanged-transform semantics need consumer review.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psappsrt:psAddGeneratorAppSRT
facts.value: Allocation failure leaves subsystem accounting unchanged and returns NULL. Successful allocation creates a detached record with next and generator pointers null, usedCount set to 1, frameNum set to 0, translation and rotation set to zero, scale set to one, and no free callback. It then advances the live-record count and conditionally advances the peak-record count.
facts.reason: TU independent review: rotation XYZ only explicitly initialized; count increments have u16 wrap without guard. Unqualified rotation/count-increase claim needs narrower wording or valid configuration/count precondition.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psappsrt:psAttachGeneratorAppSRT
facts.value: Attachment is permitted only when both pointers are non-null and the generator's appsrt slot is empty. Failure leaves both objects unchanged and returns -1. Success changes the generator from unattached to attached, adds one reference to the AppSRT, and returns its new use count.
facts.reason: TU independent review: rotation XYZ only explicitly initialized; count increments have u16 wrap without guard. Unqualified rotation/count-increase claim needs narrower wording or valid configuration/count precondition.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psappsrt:psAttachParticleAppSRT
facts.value: Attachment fails without mutation when the SRT is null, the particle is null, or the particle already has an AppSRT, returning -1. Otherwise the particle transitions from no AppSRT to referencing the supplied record, whose shared-use count increases by one.
facts.reason: TU independent review: rotation XYZ only explicitly initialized; count increments have u16 wrap without guard. Unqualified rotation/count-increase claim needs narrower wording or valid configuration/count precondition.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/psappsrt:psInitAppSRT
facts.value: Calling psInitAppSRT transitions the AppSRT allocator bookkeeping to a clean startup state: both live-allocation and peak-allocation counts become zero, the configured record size is replaced, and the allocator descriptor is reinitialized as an empty registered pool with unlimited default limits and a four-byte-aligned stride. The function reports false regardless of the supplied arguments.
facts.reason: Allocator registration/default-limit internals are foreign and were not read.
